stories.title: A langur walks into a phone shop and hugs the owner
stories.summary: CCTV from a mobile repair shop in Odisha, stamped Oct 22, shows a grey langur hopping onto the counter, climbing into the lap of the shopkeeper, who is busy on his phone, and resting its head on his chest twice while a man in a yellow shirt slips out of the shop. The shopkeeper's Instagram post passed 227 million views, and Buitengebieden's "We all need a hug sometimes.." carried it on X (15K likes). Replies praised the shopkeeper for staying perfectly still, and one asked on the langur's behalf, "Why you no hug me back?"
